title: Analyst – Documentation
description:
Job Title: Analyst – Documentation

Department: Customer Service & Documentation

Reporting To: Manager – Customer Service and Documentation

Direct Reports: N/A


Job Purpose

The Documentation Analyst is responsible for the efficient handling import/export documentation, ensuring compliance with Brazilian Federal Revenue (RFB) regulations, supporting customers with document requirements, maintaining system integrity, and coordinating with ports, terminals, carriers, and stakeholders. The role ensures timely submissions, documentation accuracy, and professional interactions to support seamless cargo handling.


Main Tasks and Responsibilities

Customer Service & Documentation Handling

- Ensure shipping documentation accuracy including BL issuance, corrections, and approvals

- Respond to customer requests regarding BL, arrival, clearance, cargo information, and deadlines

- Support customers in submitting required guarantees (e.G., LOIs, letters, payments)

- Maintain communication with vessels, carriers, terminals, and agents


Regulatory Compliance & System Processing

- Update Carrier systems and internal agency systems

- Ensure BL updates, approvals, and registry details follow Carrier process and Brazilian Regulations as per RFB IN 800 deadlines

- Maintain correct data in Siscomex Carga, safeguarding the interest of the agency and carriers

- Support customers in submitting required guarantees (e.G., LOIs, letters, payments)

- Assist with process of cargo authorization and release document validation


Confidentiality & Compliance

- Ensure confidentiality of customer and company data

- Follow code of ethics, compliance, and data protection protocols

- Maintain audit-ready documentation standards


Team & Departmental Support

- Assist the Manager as required

- Maintain collaborative relationships with colleagues, service providers, and customers

- Promote a professional, efficient, and cooperative working environment


Key Interactions

Internal: Operations, Finance, Commercial

External: Customers, Agents, Carriers, Terminal Operators, Port Authorities


Core Competencies (Grade C – Professional Band)

- Integrity & Accountability - Ensures accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance in documentation activities

- Customer Focus – Provides reliable service and support to internal and external customers

- Continuous Learning – Understands documentation regulations and system updates

- Agility – Manages multiple shipments, deadlines, and last-minute changes effectively

- Collaboration & Communication – Works effectively with various stakeholders


Functional Competencies (Grade C – Professional Band)

- Regulatory Compliance – Knowledge of Brazilian customs requirements and manifest process

- Data Accuracy & Quality Control – Maintains high data integrity and timely document handling

- Customer Service Orientation – Maintains customer satisfaction through professional service

- ERP/Data System Proficiency – Uses digital systems for data entry and process control


Education and Experience Requirements

Education:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Logistics, or related field


Experience:

- Minimum 2 years’ experience in documentation, shipping, or port regulatory processing

- Familiarity with Siscomex, Mercante/Siscarga, and Brazilian RFB processes

- Proficiency in MS Office and shipping/ERP tools

- English – Fluent;
Portuguese - Fluent


Work Environment & Specific Requirements

- Office-based role with potential port or terminal document runs

- Requires high accuracy, attention to detail, and deadline discipline

- May require extended working hours during vessel cut-offs or peak operational periods

title: Strategy And Planning Expert
description:
What You'll Do

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly strategic and analytical Strategy & Planning Expert to join our team and lead the business evolution of our Innovation vertical. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the business model, managing the end-to-end P&L, and serving as the Project Management Office (PMO) for key implementation projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of strategic vision, financial acumen, and operational process design skills to drive sustainable growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Model Evolution : Design and continuously evolve the business model for the Innovation vertical, including market entry strategies, new service offerings, and go-to-market approaches.
  • P&L Management : Own and manage the P&L for the vertical, including financial forecasting, budget planning, and variance analysis. Identify and execute initiatives to improve profitability and top-line growth.
  • Strategic Planning : Develop and lead the strategic planning process for the vertical, identifying market trends, competitive threats, and growth opportunities. Translate strategy into actionable, measurable plans.
  • PMO for Implementation : Serve as the Project Management Office for all strategic initiatives and key implementation projects within the vertical. Define project scope, manage timelines, track progress, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Process Design & Improvement : Design, map, and implement new business processes to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and performance. Conduct root cause analysis to identify process bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Product, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure alignment on strategy and execution.
  • Stakeholder Management : Communicate project updates, financial performance, and strategic direction to key stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Performance Analysis : Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure business model health, project success, and operational effectiveness.


What We Need From You

  • Education : Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly desirable.
  • Experience : Proven experience in a strategy, planning, business development, or management consulting role, with significant experience in P&L management and process design. Experience in the Food Delivery sector is a plus.
  • Strategic Acumen : Strong ability to think strategically, analyze complex business problems, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Analytical Skills : Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong financial modeling and forecasting skills.
  • Project Management : Expertise in project management methodologies and tools, with experience managing complex, cross-functional projects.
  • Process Design : Experience in mapping, designing, and optimizing business processes.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Leadership : A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive change in a fast-paced environment.

The role ensures timely submissions, documentation accuracy, and professional interactions to support seamless cargo handling.

- Respond to customer requests regarding BL, arrival, clearance, cargo information, and deadlines

- Support customers in submitting required guarantees (e.G., LOIs, letters, payments)

- Maintain communication with vessels, carriers, terminals, and agents


Regulatory Compliance & System Processing

- Update Carrier systems and internal agency systems

- Ensure BL updates, approvals, and registry details follow Carrier process and Brazilian Regulations as per RFB IN 800 deadlines

- Maintain correct data in Siscomex Carga, safeguarding the interest of the agency and carriers

- Support customers in submitting required guarantees (e.G., LOIs, letters, payments)

- Assist with process of cargo authorization and release document validation


Confidentiality & Compliance

- Ensure confidentiality of customer and company data

- Follow code of ethics, compliance, and data protection protocols

- Maintain audit-ready documentation standards


Team & Departmental Support

- Assist the Manager as required

- Maintain collaborative relationships with colleagues, service providers, and customers

- Promote a professional, efficient, and cooperative working environment


Key Interactions

Internal: Operations, Finance, Commercial

title: Senior Executive – Demurrage & Detention
description:
Job Title: Senior Executive – Demurrage & Detention

Department: Finance

Reporting To: Manager – Finance


Job Purpose:

The Senior Executive – Demurrage & Detention is responsible for managing, monitoring, and controlling demurrage and detention charges across import and export shipments. The role ensures accurate calculation, timely billing, dispute resolution, cost recovery, and compliance with carrier contracts and internal policies. The position plays a critical role in minimizing financial exposure, protecting margins, and supporting operational efficiency within the shipping agency.


Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

Demurrage & Detention Management

  • Monitor demurrage and detention exposure for all import and export shipments.
  • Calculate demurrage and detention charges accurately as per carrier tariffs, contracts, and free-time agreements.
  • Coordinate closely with Operations and Documentation teams to track container movements and free-time utilization.
  • Ensure timely issuance and follow-up of demurrage and detention invoices to customers.


Dispute Resolution & Recovery

  • Handle demurrage and detention disputes with customers, terminals, and carriers.
  • Prepare and submit waiver, extension, or reduction requests supported by proper documentation.
  • Follow up on approvals, settlements, and recoveries to minimize financial losses.
  • Maintain detailed records of disputed and approved cases for audit and reporting.


Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare periodic demurrage and detention reports highlighting exposure, recoveries, and outstanding risks.
  • Analyze root causes of high demurrage and detention costs and propose corrective actions.
  • Share insights with management to improve operational planning and container turnaround.


Compliance & Controls

  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, approval matrices, and contractual terms.
  • Maintain accurate documentation for audit readiness and management review.
  • Ensure adherence to Brazilian regulatory and documentation requirements related to invoicing and collections.


Stakeholder Coordination

  • Coordinate with internal teams (Operations, Finance, Customer Service, Commercial) for issue resolution.
  • Communicate professionally with customers, carriers, terminals, and depots regarding charges and disputes.
  • Support management initiatives to reduce long-stayed containers and operational inefficiencies.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Reduction in demurrage and detention costs through proactive management and recovery – 30%
  • Timely and accurate calculation and billing of demurrage and detention charges – 25%
  • Successful resolution and recovery of disputed demurrage and detention cases – 20%
  • Timely submission of reports and visibility on exposure and risks – 15%
  • Compliance with internal controls, contracts, and audit requirements – 10%


Key Interactions:

Internal: Operations, Documentation, Finance, Customer Service, Commercial

External: Customers, Shipping Lines, Terminals, Depots, Auditors (as required)


Core Competencies (Grade D – Professional Level):

  • Integrity & Accountability: Ensures accuracy, transparency, and ethical handling of financial exposures.
  • Customer Focus: Balances customer relationships with cost recovery and contractual compliance.
  • Continuous Learning: Keeps updated on carrier tariffs, free-time rules, and operational practices.
  • Agility: Responds effectively to operational challenges and tight deadlines.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Works closely with cross-functional teams to resolve issues.


Functional Competencies (Grade D – Professional Level):

  • Demurrage & Detention Expertise: Strong understanding of free time, tariffs, and carrier contracts.
  • Dispute & Claims Management: Ability to manage negotiations and documentation for charge reductions.
  • Operational Coordination: Works with operations to reduce container dwell time.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Interprets exposure data to support decision-making.
  • ERP & Operational Systems: Proficient in shipping and accounting systems used for tracking charges.
  • Attention to Detail: Ensures accuracy in calculations, documentation, and reporting.


Education and Experience Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Shipping, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.


Experience:

  • 4–6 years of experience in demurrage and detention management within a shipping agency or logistics environment.
  • Strong exposure to import/export operations and container lifecycle management.
  • Experience dealing with carriers, terminals, and depots.
  • Experience in shipping, liner agency, or freight forwarding operations preferred.
  • Portuguese – Fluent (required).
  • English – Fluent (required).


Work Environment and Specific Requirements:

  • Office-based role with close coordination with operations and finance teams.
  • Requires high attention to detail, strong follow-up, and negotiation skills.
  • May require extended working hours during peak operational periods or vessel delays.
  • Reports directly to the Manager – Operations/ Finance for task allocation and performance review.

title: Executive - Equipment Control
description:
Job Title: Executive – Equipment Control

Department: Operations

Reporting To: Manager – Operations

Direct Reports: N/A


Job Purpose:

The Executive – Equipment Control is responsible for overseeing container equipment inventory, ensuring effective coordination with depots and state agents, and maintaining accurate, real-time tracking of container movements. The role focuses on optimizing equipment utilization, planning asset allocation, resolving operational challenges, and supporting smooth logistics operations across Brazil and neighboring regions including Argentina, Uruguay, and Paraguay.


Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

Equipment Inventory Management & Planning

  • Maintain and update daily container equipment inventory statistics with high accuracy.
  • Monitor stock levels and prepare equipment allocation plans based on operational demand.
  • Analyze historical data and trends to optimize equipment availability and positioning.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure efficient equipment flow.


Depot & Vendor Coordination

  • Act as the primary liaison between container depots and state agents for equipment movements.
  • Coordinate with depot teams to track inbound and outbound container flows.
  • Resolve depot-related operational issues and monitor vendor performance to ensure service reliability.


Container Tracking & Documentation

  • Update and maintain container movement logs accurately in the tracking system.
  • Ensure data integrity and investigate discrepancies in equipment records.
  • Generate regular reports on equipment utilization, stock availability, and movement history.


Issue Resolution & Process Improvement

  • Identify and resolve equipment-related operational issues in a timely manner.
  • Work closely with Operations and Commercial teams to address inefficiencies in equipment allocation.
  • Propose process improvements to enhance tracking accuracy, turnaround time, and operational efficiency.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Maintain 100% accuracy in daily equipment inventory records, with discrepancies below 0.5% per quarter – 25%
  • Submit equipment allocation plans within 24 hours, achieving at least 95% alignment with operational demand – 20%
  • Ensure 98% on-time execution of equipment movements with minimal escalations – 20%
  • Resolve 95% of reported equipment-related issues within 24 hours – 15%
  • Ensure 100% real-time container movement updates with zero data gaps – 20%


Key Interactions:

Internal: Finance, HR & Admin, Operations, Procurement, Commercial

External: Vendors, Banks, Auditors, Statutory Authorities



Education and Experience Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Maritime Studies, Logistics, or related field
  • Specialization in Supply Chain Management, Maritime Operations, or Business Management
  • Master’s degree is preferred


Certifications & Training:

  • Professional certifications in Supply Chain Management, Maritime Operations, or Logistics (preferred)
  • Training in equipment flow optimization, compliance, and data management


Language Requirements:

  • English – Fluent
  • Portuguese – Required
  • Spanish – Optional / Advantage


Background and Experience:

Work Experience:

  • Industry: Shipping, Logistics, Freight Forwarding
  • Role Exposure: Equipment Management, Fleet Control, Logistics Coordination
  • Experience Range: 4–6 years


Core Competencies (Level 1 – Grades A–D):

  • Integrity & Accountability – Organizes work effectively, prioritizes tasks, and takes ownership of responsibilities
  • Customer Focus – Understands customer needs and ensures service delivery meets expectations
  • Continuous Learning – Actively seeks feedback, training, and applies new knowledge
  • Collaboration & Communication – Communicates clearly and supports teamwork proactively
  • Agility – Adapts to change and manages evolving operational priorities effectively


Functional Competencies:

  • Equipment Control & Management – Expertise in container inventory, allocation, and equipment flow
  • Logistics Coordination – Strong understanding of equipment movement within shipping operations
  • Data Analysis & Reporting – Ability to generate and interpret utilization and stock reports
  • Regulatory Compliance – Knowledge of industry regulations related to equipment control
  • Technology & Automation – Experience with equipment tracking systems and inventory tools


Work Environment & Specific Requirements:

  • Office-based role with regular coordination with depots, terminals, and vendors
  • Occasional travel to depots and equipment facilities as required
  • Requires strong attention to detail, coordination skills, and operational discipline

title: Software Engineer Autosar
description:
Embedded Software Developer - Betim, Brazil - KPIT


Join KPIT, a global leader in automotive technology, and contribute to the future of mobility! We are seeking a talented and motivated Embedded Software Developer to join our team in Betim, Brazil. This is a hybrid role offering a dynamic work environment and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge automotive projects.


About KPIT:

KPIT is a trusted partner to automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, delivering innovative technology solutions in areas like electrification, autonomous driving, and connected car technologies. We offer a challenging and rewarding work environment with opportunities for growth and development.


Role Overview:

As an Embedded Software Developer, you will be responsible for the development of embedded software using automated code generation methodologies. You will play a crucial role in the design, implementation, and validation of software components for automotive applications.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Software Development: Develop embedded software using Matlab tools (Simulink and Stateflow toolboxes) and DSpace Targetlink and SystemDesk.
  • Code Generation: Utilize automated code generation techniques to produce high-quality, efficient code.
  • AUTOSAR Expertise: Apply and maintain expertise in AUTOSAR architecture and configuration.
  • Code Quality: Implement and adhere to static code analysis methodologies and tools (MISRA C) to ensure code quality and safety.
  • Project Management: Contribute to project management efforts, demonstrating self-management and adherence to project timelines.
  • Maturity Models: Apply knowledge of software maturity models (A-Spice, CMMI or MPS-BR) to improve development processes.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions.


Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Matlab Proficiency: Advanced knowledge and practical experience with Matlab.
  • Simulink Expertise: Mandatory knowledge and experience with Simulink.
  • Code Generation: Advanced understanding of automatic code generation principles and practices.
  • AUTOSAR Knowledge: Deep understanding of AUTOSAR architecture and configuration.
  • Code Analysis: Familiarity with static code analysis tools and methodologies (MISRA C).
  • Project Management: Understanding of project management principles and techniques.
  • Industry Standards: Knowledge of automotive industry standards.
  • Maturity Models: Knowledge of software maturity models (A-Spice, CMMI, or MPS-BR).


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Hybrid work model.
  • Opportunity to work on innovative automotive projects.
  • Collaborative and supportive work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth.

title: Analista Florestal Pl - Ppcm
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais Atividades:

  • Planejar e programar as ordens de manutenção da frota florestal, considerando demanda operacional, capacidade de execução, criticidade dos ativos e impactos em custo e disponibilidade;
  • Acompanhar e analisar a execução do plano de manutenção, avaliando desvios de prazo, custo e escopo, e propondo ações de correção e otimização;
  • Analisar custosde manutenção da frota (materiais, serviços e horas), identificando oportunidades de redução de desperdícios e aumento da eficiência operacional;
  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter planos de manutenção preventiva e preditiva, com foco na confiabilidade dos ativos, redução de falhas e otimização do custo do ciclo de vida;
  • Monitorar, analisar e consolidar indicadores de desempenho da manutenção e da frota, elaborando relatórios gerenciais e análises críticas para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Atuar na padronização, controle e melhoria contínua dos processos de PPCM, contribuindo para o aumento da maturidade da gestão de manutenção;
  • Interagir com áreas como operação, manutenção, suprimentos e almoxarifado, garantindo o alinhamento das informações e a adequada provisão de recursos;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas, análises de conformidade e revisões de processos, assegurando a aderência aos padrões estabelecidos e às diretrizes de gestão de ativos;
  • Participar de reuniões de planejamento, acompanhamento e revisão de resultados de manutenção, apresentando análises técnicas, indicadores e impactos financeiros.

Requisitos:

  • Disponibilidade para residir em Três Lagoas/MS;
  • Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção Administração ou áreas corretadas;
  • Conhecimento emferramentas de planejamento e controle de manutenção (ERP, MRP, SAP);
  • Excel avançado,Power BI ou ferramenta similar de BI.

title: Doutores Inovando No Setor Empresarial - Chavi Tecnologia - Desenvolvimento De Fechadura Inteligente
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.


Sobre a Oportunidade:


A Chavi é uma startup paranaense que desenvolve soluções de gerenciamento de acesso inteligente , substituindo chaves físicas por tecnologia: suas fechaduras e dispositivos digitais permitem abrir portas via smartphone, com controle seguro e remoto de acesso.

O hardware e o software são desenvolvidos internamente por uma equipe multidisciplinar de engenheiros eletrônicos, mecânicos e de computação — o que garante controle completo sobre o produto e independência tecnológica.

Projeto: Desenvolvimento de Fechadura Inteligente

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo Engenharia Mecatrônica, Engenharia Elétrica e Engenharia Eletrônica.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.


Principais Atividades:

  • Projetar placa (PCB) e esquema elétrico.
  • Selecionar microcontrolador e componentes.
  • Dimensionar alimentação e gerenciar consumo de energia.
  • Implementar circuitos de proteção e gerenciamento de bateria.
  • Integrar interfaces para módulos de comunicação (BLE, Wi-Fi, NB-IoT).
  • Desenvolver firmware para placa eletrônica.
  • Implementar sistema seguro de boot e atualizações OTA.
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento da estrutura física do produto.
  • Definir motor e materiais.
  • Contribuir para definição do processo de montagem e testes.
  • Implementar criptografia, armazenamento seguro e autenticação.
  • Preparar documentação e apoiar certificações.
  • Elaborar documentação técnica, guias e materiais de instalação.

  • Conhecimento em eletrônica e experiência em desenvolvimento de IoT.


Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de produtos eletromecânicos de precisão.

title: Lead Developer
description:
ADP is hiring a Lead Developer


You will start your day on a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goal with your team. You will spend most of your day designing, developing and testing your code and supporting your team members. You will be able to deploy your code in production using automated continuous integration and continuous deployment.

You will work with product managers, analysts, architects, and engineers to plan, design, develop, test, and implement information technology solutions.


Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:


  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silo. You'll talk to everyone from the project manager to Quality Assurance and current customers to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open-source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:


  • Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience on web application development.
  • Advanced understanding development using JavaScript frameworks.
  • Advanced English
  • Experience with Java;
  • Know best practices around software development, SDLC, unit testing, frontend performance tuning, be able to share this knowledge with others in the team.
  • Experience using CI and CD pipelines
  • Technical Analysis – analyzing systems, problems, programs, formulating solutions.
  • Technical Design – ensuring that all work undertaken is of sound design and fits in with the existing architecture.
  • Participates in requirements gathering and reviews, assesses technical feasibility, assists in defining solutions, and prepares development artifacts where required.
  • Conducts code walk through and reviews with team members.
  • Monitors changes in technology;
    remains up to date on current industry trends and internal architecture practices, principles, models and standards;
    trains technical staff on new technologies.


HOW YOU’LL STAND OUT:


  • Nice to have, develop frontend framework for other teams
  • Develop frontend web applications in NodeJS and React
  • Support production software operations, test and debug programs
  • Make a good use of the CI and CD pipeline
  • Self-taught worker: capable of learning and applying by himself
  • Self-guided worker: capable of working with different product teams with little supervision after the initial learning period
  • Strong collaboration skills: ability to establish good relationships with the stakeholders
  • Developer empathy: ability to empathize with developers, by being flexible in solution design without compromising best practices and standards.
  • Improvisation (lateral thinking): the ability to think across disciplines and existing boundaries (technologies/business/geographies)
  • Research: an inclination to continuous research inside and outside of the current focus fields.


*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

title: Sr Demand Planning And Product Analyst
description:
The Sr Demand Planning & Product Analyst support the demand forecasting process for the respective business channels to generate a perspective on unit demand. He/she facilitates discussions with business stakeholders by channel to reconcile unit level forecasts against financial targets, key initiatives and productivity. The Demand Planning & Product Analyst oversees that POs are placed in accordance with forecasting alignment with each channel, in a timely fashion to ensure adequate inventory levels (launch and sustain).

The mains responsibility will be to ensure optimal level of stocks using analytical, marketing, and sales data to avoid ruptures and depreciation.


Overall

  • Facilitates monthly forecast/planning meetings with business areas, discussing current trends and risks/opportunities.
  • Educates business areas on demand forecasting processes and requirements, ensuring alignment between Demand Plan and Financial Forecast- identifying gaps and generating solutions to reconcile them.
  • Implements best practices for the planning function and partners with channels to ensure the best and necessary data to analyze and drive the business
  • Participate in major go-to-market milestones to gain insight to key seasonal strategies and initiatives.
  • Aligns OTB processes by channel to meet sales, margin, and inventory turn targets, Rolling Demand Plan and markdown plans. Ensures POs and Transfer orders are places accordingly.
  • Support in-market stock position assuring the right volumes are available on DTCs business and Retail doors.
  • Communicates delivery constraints, operational issues/opportunities. Flags irreconcilable issues to manager for problem solving and escalation as needed.
  • Drives the development and roll-out of tools to support demand planning efforts and data collection defining and establishing “best in class” planning processes and driving strategic and continuous improvement activities
  • Provides quarterly & seasonal historical data analysis & insight as inputs for future planning
  • Leads demand planning monthly reporting, developing and monitoring KPIs to track forecasting accuracy and other key metrics (inventory aging and obsolescence).


DEMAND PLANNING

  • Use analytical, marketing, and sales data to effectively estimate future product demands.
  • Duties include planning inventory flow, analyzing statistical data, and generating forecasting solutions.


IMPORTATION

  • Support Marketing Manager to build and control importation orders including promotional items
  • Follow-up shipments and guide commercial teams on ruptures/overstock
  • Control and manage depreciation


KPIS

  • Understand brand’s metrics and improve DOI KPI
  • Keep track of brand’s fill rate


MARKET ANALYSIS

  • Support Marketing Manager gather and analyze constant information on the Market evolution, trends and competitors
  • Price Analysis and Price Tables Updates

title: Managing Director - Crypto Payment
description:
Location: Brazil (must currently reside in Brazil with valid Brazilian ID)

Language: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory), strong English preferred



Summary:

We are seeking an experienced, crypto-savvy Managing Director to lead and expand our crypto payment business in Brazil. The ideal candidate must be Brazil-based, with prior experience in crypto, deep knowledge of the local crypto/payment ecosystem, and strong relationships with key regulatory and industry stakeholders. This role is critical to supporting Brazil licensing efforts, including assisting with the DASP licence, and will work closely with the Brazil AMLO on regulatory matters.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the company in obtaining the DASP licence, collaborating closely with AMLO Brazil on all regulatory submissions and compliance preparations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) to support licensing and ongoing regulatory engagement.
  • Expand business development opportunities through a strong local network across crypto, payments, fintech, and financial institutions.
  • Lead Brazil's business strategy and drive growth for all crypto-payment products.
  • Maintain excellent relationships with crypto industry associations such as ABCripto, ABCB, and other relevant bodies.
  • Represent the company as the senior business leader in Brazil, attending industry events, regulatory meetings, and partnership discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with global teams (product, compliance, legal, operations) to ensure commercial success and regulatory alignment.



Requirements:

  • Must currently reside in Brazil with a valid Brazilian ID.
  • Prior experience in crypto is a must.
  • 10+ years’ experience in crypto payments, payment institutions, fintech, or related financial services.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto/payment regulatory environment, including BCB and CVM frameworks.
  • Proven track record and strong personal network with BCB, CVM, and major industry associations (ABCripto, ABCB).
  • Demonstrated ability to support licensing processes for payment or crypto-related entities in Brazil.
  • Strong business development experience, with a proven ability to grow partnerships and drive commercial expansion.
  • Fluent Portuguese;
    strong English preferred.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment.



Vision & Mission:

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
Our future is yours!

Who are we?

We are Bridge Polymers, an international company with multiple branches across Europe and

beyond. We trade in polyolefins - something you’ve probably never heard of, yet encounter

every day. These are types of plastic with hundreds of different applications. Our customers use

these plastic pellets to create their products. Our suppliers are global producers of

petrochemicals, and we focus primarily on trading polyethylene and polypropylene.

Bridge Polymers has offices in several countries, including Spain, Poland, Romania, Brazil and

more, with our headquarters based in Eindhoven, the Netherlands. The market we operate in is

fast-paced. Thanks to our straightforward, honest, and down-to-earth company culture, we can

perform at our best even in the hectic world of fast trading. We are flexible and work with short

lines of communication, allowing us to always stay on top of the business!


Your responsibilities

Working at Bridge Polymers means working on your own future within a dynamic company. This

is especially true for the Inside Sales Specialist we are currently seeking. How your journey

unfolds and where you ultimately end up is largely in your own hands.

As an Inside Sales Specialist, you will receive a structured onboarding and development

program designed to help you quickly gain confidence in your role. From day one, you will be

actively contributing while deepening your knowledge in the following areas:

Business Development & Prospection

● Research new markets and identify potential commercial opportunities.

● Analyse import statistics and market data to uncover new prospects.

● Proactively engage with potential customers through calls, emails, and LinkedIn.

● Set up daily meetings with prospects to explore potential collaborations.

● Contact customers to understand their product requirements and gather relevant market

intelligence.

Sales Support

● Prepare, create, and send offers and proformas.

● Manage follow-ups to support the full sales cycle from lead to deal.

● Assist in applying for credit limits and monitoring customer credit status.

● Follow up on payments, required documentation, and overall deal progress.

Customer Administration

● Handle day-to-day communication with prospects and clients.

● Ensure all customer data, requests, and feedback are accurately documented and

managed.

● Support the sales team by maintaining a smooth and organized administrative workflow.

In short: an excellent career outlook - and it’s up to you to fulfil your potential.


Requirements

● You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, International trade or similar field.

● You have at least 1–2 years of experience in a sales or business development role.

● Knowledge of import/export processes and B2B sales is a strong advantage.

● You are independent, ambitious, commercially minded, proactive, and able to perform

under pressure.

● You are fluent in spoken and written English and Portuguese.

● You are able to travel to Blumenau 2 or 3 days a week.


What we offer

● Excellent employment conditions.

● Salary progression linked to your personal growth and performance.

● Mentorship from experienced professionals to support your development.

● The opportunity to be part of a dynamic, international team.

Temos uma visão clara de futuro e, para realizá-la, precisamos de talentos que compartilhem dessa energia, garra e um foco inabalável em resultados . Não procuramos apenas "tiradores de pedidos", mas sim estrategistas de campo , com a capacidade de construir e nutrir relacionamentos que gerem valor real e resultados financeiros expressivos para a empresa e para si.


O desafio é grande e empolgante: Vamos impulsionar o volume de vendas dos nossos Serviços Gerenciados . Isso significa identificar oportunidades, inovar na abordagem e, acima de tudo, ser um parceiro estratégico para os nossos clientes.

Construir relacionamentos duradouros e de confiança é a chave, e sabemos que quem tem o DNA de vendas ama esse processo.


· Orientação para Ganhos e Performance: Acreditamos que o reconhecimento é a maior alavanca. Sua energia e dedicação se refletirão diretamente no volume de interações, propostas e, claro, no fechamento de negócios. O comissionamento aqui não é um bônus, é a celebração do seu impacto direto e da sua capacidade de gerar resultados financeiros que farão a diferença. Sabemos que um profissional de alta performance é naturalmente "drivado" por isso.

Sua iniciativa para ir além, para inovar e para ver seu trabalho traduzido em crescimento – tanto pessoal quanto financeiro – é o que nos move.


· Sinergia e Suporte de Elite: Você não estará sozinho. Terá ao seu lado um time estratégico de Pré-Vendas, além das áreas de CS, Projetos e Delivery, que atuam de forma colaborativa, compartilhando conhecimento e somando forças para garantir o sucesso coletivo em cada etapa da jornada.

title: Sales Consultant
description:
We are looking for a Sales Consultant to strengthen our ambitious sales team in São Paulo, Brazil . You will work with the leading telematics solutions in the world and master your B2B sales skills In this position, you will belong to the Telematics Sales Team .



Teltonika’s telematics business unit develops and produces easy-to-use GPS tracking devices for effective fleet management in logistics, agriculture, car sharing, construction, and more. Using the latest technologies, Teltonika sets new standards for the telematics industry.


In this role, you will:

  • Contribute to market research, including identifying market potential and finding potential leads
  • Reaching out to new potential clients via cold calling, email, and LinkedIn communication
  • Prepare commercial offers and ensure contracts to achieve assigned sales goals
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with new and existing customers through daily contact and frequent visits
  • Attend exhibitions/meetings to represent Teltonika and its products with solutions


What we expect of you:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (both spoken and written), it will be a differential to have good English language skills (B1 or higher level)
  • Knowledge of and good experience with CRM systems.
  • Strong motivation to work in B2B sales (sales experience will be considered an advantage)
  • Good understanding of customer relations
  • Ambition to generate substantial earnings by conquering markets with an innovative product.
  • An organized and results-oriented approach and a challenge-driven personality
  • Willing to travel (when circumstances allow)
  • Previous work experience selling technology products (preferably hardware or telematics products).


What we offer:

  • Salary : We appreciate everyone's efforts and experiences, so we offer an attractive salary matching your skillset and field expertise.
  • Career : Great opportunities to grow in a strong and rapidly expanding company.
  • Work model: Hybrid (4 days in person and one remote)
  • Catering benefits: Cartão Caju (Vale Refeição of R$35 per working days + Saldo Livre of R$750 monthly + R$09 per working day), coffee and fruits provided in the office;
  • Health and Well-being Benefits: TotalPass, SESC membership, healthcare, dental care, and life insurance.
  • Teambuilding: regular office celebrations and events that help us to get to know each other better.
  • Caring and supportive team: we constantly seek for our employees to have better leadership while regularly sending our managers to external coaching sessions, conducting annual employee engagement surveys, and other management and HRD initiatives to help our employees overcome bottlenecks and challenges.




Teltonika aspires to become one of the global leaders in providing unique IoT solutions that contribute to making people’s lives easier. Since 1998, we have gained considerable experience and competence in electronics development and production. Today, our areas of expertise include telematics, networking, telemedicine, EV charging, and electronics manufacturing. While proactively searching for new ideas and ways to create more value for our clients, we also hope to create a better future for our employees and the communities we operate in. Our organizational culture is based on mutual trust and respect as well as creating synergy with our employees and clients.

title: Especialista Fullstack - Mobile
description:
Com 70 anos de existência, o Einstein Hospital Israelita ainda mantém uma premissa: inovar e crescer, sempre com excelência. Ajudamos a salvar vidas, difundir o conhecimento em educação, prevenção e inovação em saúde. Além da atuação em setores assistenciais, temos oportunidades na área de Inovação, Tecnologia, Pesquisa, Ensino, entre outras. Seguimos oferecendo qualidade, afirmando nosso compromisso com a Responsabilidade Social e com o propósito de levar uma gota de Einstein para cada cidadão. Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão de todos os talentos e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem deste mesmo propósito!


Informações sobre a vaga

  • Carga Horária : 220h/mês
  • Local de trabalho : Unidade Faria Lima
  • Modelo de trabalho : Híbrido

Atribuições:

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento mobile utilizando React Native e tecnologias nativas (iOS/Android), garantindo alta performance, qualidade e experiência do usuário.
  • Desenvolver e evoluir APIs em Node.Js + TypeScript, conectando o app ao backend com foco em segurança, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Atuar como referência técnica, participando de code reviews, decisões arquiteturais e apoiando o time em boas práticas.
  • Colaborar com Produto, UX/UI e QA, transformando requisitos em soluções simples, escaláveis e orientadas ao usuário.
  • Garantir qualidade aplicando padrões de arquitetura, monitoramento, integração contínua e melhorias de performance.
  • Propor evoluções técnicas, identificar gargalos e contribuir para a melhoria do ecossistema mobile + backend.

Requisitos

Imprescindíveis :

  • Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • Especialização completa;
  • Mobile (Core davaga)
  • Experiência avançada com React Native (componentização, performance, animações, navegação, build e publicação).
  • Conhecimento sólido em desenvolvimento nativo Android (Kotlin) e/ou iOS (Swift).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas mobile modernas: Clean Architecture, MVVM, Redux/MobX/Zustand, modularização, injeção de dependência.
  • Experiência com CI/CD mobile (Fastlane, App Center, Gradle, Bitrise, CodePush).
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento mobile (Firebase Crashlytics).
  • Experiência com CodePush e distribuição avançada.
  • Backend
  • Domínio de Node.Js + TypeScript.
  • Construção e manutenção de APIs REST (versionamento, documentação, testes, segurança).
  • Vivência com arquitetura de microsserviços e integração com apps mobile.
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e/ou NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB).
  • Experiência com autenticação/autorização (JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect).
  • DevOps e Qualidade
  • Conhecimento em Git, pipelines de CI/CD e versionamento (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Conhecimento em Docker e conceitos de Kubernetes.
  • Clean Code, SOLID e Design Patterns.

Desejável

  • Experiência com GraphQL.
  • Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Vivência com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS (Lambda, S3, ECS, RDS).
  • Participação em projetos na área da saúde.
  • Experiência com Flutter.
  • Domínio de observabilidade com Dynatrace.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Análise Curricular
  • Entrevista com RH e Gestor
  • Ressaltamos que todas as etapas são de caráter eliminatório.


Einstein Benefícios – Compartilhando Bem-Estar

  • Cuidados com a saúde: Programa Cuidar com serviços realizados no Einstein para promover a saúde e bem-estar dos colaboradores e dependentes, Clínicas Einstein, Telemedicina, Convênio Farmácia, Convênio Médico, Assistência Odontológica e Consultório Dental in Company.
  • Bem-Estar: Wellhub (Gympass), TotalPass, Coral, Programa de Orientação Pessoal e SESC.
  • Para você e sua família: Licença paternidade estendida, Seguro de Vida, Creche ou Auxílio Creche para mães ou pais com guarda legal, Auxílio para Filhos com Deficiência e Previdência Privada com taxa zero.
  • Alimentação: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição ou Refeitório no local de trabalho.
  • Mobilidade: Vale Transporte, Fretado, Estacionamento, Aplicativo de Caronas e Circular Metrô.
  • Clube de Benefícios: Para economizar e obter vantagens nas compras de produtos e serviços de diversas categorias, como Beleza e Fitness, Comer e Beber, Compras, Cultura e Lazer, Educação Ensino Einstein, Turismo e muito mais.
  • Programa Mais Conectados: Trabalho remoto nas modalidades Teletrabalho ou Híbrido conforme atividade e área de atuação.

title: Assistente De Operações
description:

Se você é alguém que se interessa por oferecer uma experiência única ao seu cliente, assim como aprender com novos desafios, temos uma oportunidade para você.


Primeiramente, nos apresentamos:


Somos a Greystar International: um conceito de apartamentos de aluguel totalmente equipados, com comodidades de luxo e um serviço de gerenciamento profissional que está estabelecendo o padrão no mercado. Somos a empresa líder mundial em investimentos, desenvolvimento e administração de propriedades para aluguel desde a nossa fundação em 1993.


Estamos buscando pessoas que possam agregar à equipe que cuida dos nossos residenciais estudantis, Share Student Living, e que irá nos ajudar a transformar a vida de jovens estudantes através de novas conexões e do sentimento de comunidade.

  • Manter a comunicação interna constantemente atualizada;

  • Familiaridade com mídias digitais e tecnologias.

title: Engenheiro(A) Especialista De Troubleshooting
description:
Trabalhamos por um único propósito: desenvolver o mundo com energia limpa em larga escala, e para alcançarmos este objetivo, acreditamos que as pessoas são parte fundamental desse processo.


Estamos com uma oportunidade em aberto para Engenheiro(a) Especialista de Troubleshooting – Renováveis , para atuar em nosso escritório localizado em São Paulo/SP , na região da Vila Olímpia, em modelo presencial, com um dia de home office na semana.


Objetivo do cargo : atuar no suporte técnico especializado às operações de ativos de geração renovável (eólica e solar), liderando investigações e soluções de falhas em sistemas elétricos, automação, controle, proteção e telecomunicação, bem como em equipamentos de geração. Será responsável por diagnosticar causas de falhas, propor ações corretivas, apoiar manutenções, atualizar sistemas e garantir a continuidade e eficiência operacional dos ativos.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar troubleshooting de sistemas elétricos, automação, controle, proteção, telecomunicação e equipamentos de geração (aerogeradores, inversores fotovoltaicos, etc.);
  • Diagnosticar e reportar falhas, indicando testes, inspeções e ações corretivas ou melhorias;
  • Apoiar as equipes de O&M na execução de testes, inspeções, manutenções preditivas, preventivas e corretivas;
  • Analisar registros de falhas (oscilografias), eventos e realizar testes de relés de proteção;
  • Suportar validações, atualizações de software, firmware e atividades de comissionamento pós-intervenções;
  • Elaborar políticas e procedimentos para O&M, assegurando alinhamento técnico e operacional;
  • Realizar visitas frequentes aos ativos para suporte técnico em campo, sempre que necessário.


Buscamos profissional que tenha:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Elétrica;
  • Sólida experiência em O&M ou áreas correlatas no setor de energia renovável;
  • Conhecimento avançado em sistemas elétricos de potência voltados para geração renovável;
  • Experiência avançada com equipamentos de automação, controle, proteção e telecomunicação de subestações;
  • Conhecimento avançado em equipamentos de geração (aerogeradores, inversores fotovoltaicos) e protocolos como IEC61850, DNP3, OPC, Modbus, entre outros;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Capacidade de atuação autônoma em campo, perfil proativo e foco em resolução de problemas.


Benefícios que geram energia:

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Remuneração Variável Anual (PPR);
  • Vale Refeição eAlimentação;
  • Auxílio Transporte, Fretado ou Estacionamento (a depender da localidade);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • TotalPass (Auxílio Academia e Bem-estar);
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade estendida;
  • Gift Card no mês do seu aniversário;
  • Gift Card de Natal.


Em nossos processos seletivos, consideramos pessoas com deficiência e de diferentes etnias, nacionalidades, gênero e orientação sexual. Dessa forma, contribuímos com uma sociedade e um ambiente de trabalho mais inclusivo, em que a diversidade nos permitirá ir ainda mais longe.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Prevenção À Lavagem De Dinheiro E Financiamento Ao Terrorismo | Banco
description:
O Banco Carrefour é a maior Fintail do Brasil e braço financeiro do Grupo Carrefour Brasil, único varejista com banco próprio. Com a missão de melhorar a vida das famílias brasileiras, dando acesso ao crédito e serviços financeiros inovadores, o Banco Carrefour é um dos maiores emissores de cartão de crédito do país, atendendo a milhões de brasileiros.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores e quer embarcar com a gente na missão de melhorar a vida das famílias brasileiras, venha fazer parte do nosso time!


#BancoCarrefour


Sobre a área:

A área de Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Financiamento ao Terrorismo (PLD/FT) do Banco Carrefour atua como um pilar estratégico de proteção e sustentabilidade do negócio. Sua missão é garantir a integridade das operações financeiras, assegurando total aderência às normas do Banco Central e órgãos reguladores.


Desafios dessa posição:

Responsável por liderar a frente operacional e tática de Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Financiamento ao Terrorismo. O foco principal é garantir a sustentação dos processos, viabilizar o lançamento de novos produtos com segurança regulatória, dar suporte e trabalhar em parceria com a área de estratégia e data analytics de PLD/FT e realizar a gestão do time.


Sustentação e Crises: Gestão do ecossistema de sistemas, controle de incidentes críticos e mitigação de riscos operacionais;

Business Enablement: Emissão de pareceres técnicos (AGR) para novos produtos, com foco estratégico em Conta Digital PF e Segmento PJ;

Performance & Data Analytics: Criação e gestão de KPIs operacionais e táticos;
transformação de dados em inteligência para reporte executivo;

Eficiência Tática: Colaboração direta com a área de Estratégia de PLD, fornecendo insumos práticos para a melhoria contínua do programa;

Compliance & Auditoria: Interface com Auditorias Internas/Externas, suporte em inspeções e garantia do cumprimento das normas vigentes;

Representação Institucional: Gestão de agendas com associações setoriais e manutenção da governança da área;

Liderança de Pessoas: Coordenação, desenvolvimento e mentoria do time técnico.


Você precisa ter:

Ensino Superior completo em Direito, Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados ou áreas afins;

Conhecimento em Pacote Office e em ferramentas Google, incluindo GCP;

Profundo conhecimento das normas do BACEN (Res. 3.966, Circ. 3.978) e regulamentações de PLD/FT;

Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e ferramentas de BI (Tableau, Power BI ou SQL);

Capacidade de estruturar Dashboards de performance e interpretar tendências de risco (Data Analytics);

Conhecimento em conta digital PF e PJ;

Experiência com gestão de pessoas;

Inglês avançado e/ou Fluente.


Adoraríamos se você tiver:

Certificações em PLD/FT;

Pós-graduação ou MBA, em andamento ou concluído, com foco em Compliance, Gestão de Riscos, Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro, Auditoria e/ou Gestão de Pessoas.

description:
Resumo do cargo:

Administrar as ordens e/ou contratos de serviços, dentro das diretrizes da organização, para assegurar o cumprimento do alcance, custos e tempo dos contratos de materiais e serviços para o cumprimento das expectativas do cliente.


Neste cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Garantir o correto manuseio das ordens, em tempo, alcance e custo;
  • Manter o arquivo Backlog atualizado;
  • Certificar-se de que a ordem de compra é colocada aos fornecedores internos/externos de todos os entregáveis da ordem;
  • Analise críticado pedido de compra;
  • Ter atualizadoo programa de entrega de suprimentos e serviços para emitir o valor estimado de faturamento mensal;
  • Identificar custos incorridos por materiais e equipamentos em inventários e/ou penalidades por descumprimento de datas de entrega das ordens de compra;
  • Participação nas reuniões de transferência de projetos, quando exigido;
  • Execução do ajuste das ordens sempre que necessário e de acordo com as regras de cada BU;
  • Pedido de faturamento das ordens de serviços e verificação do pagamento das mesmas;
  • Realização de estimativas de reconhecimento de receitas e coordenação de atividades com diferentes equipes de suporte para obter o reconhecimento estimado;
  • Coordenação da entrega dos materiais em colaboração com os diferentes equipes de suporte;
  • Colaboração como coordenador de serviços para a execução, faturamento e reconhecimento do serviço;
  • Controle de custos, inventário e ordens não faturadas;
  • Constante contato com cliente para atualização de prazos e autorização de faturamento;
  • Revisão de checklist para fechamento de ordens.


Quem é você:

Você mantém uma atitude positiva apesar da adversidade. Você demonstra uma atitude proativa em tempos bons e ruins. Você toma decisões acertadas, mesmo na ausência de informações completas. Você apresenta ideias úteis que são novas, melhores ou únicas. Você transmite calma e mantém a produtividade, mesmo quando as coisas não estão claras.


Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação superior em Administração ou Finanças;
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos na área administrativa;
  • Conhecimento emprocessos organizacionais ERP (Oracle);
  • Local de trabalho: Sorocaba, SP.


Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass);
seguro de vida;
cooperativa de crédito;
previdência privada;
reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.
